summary: CPW camping page + cpwshop per-site pages: confirmed 45 sites, water at every site, potable water, reservation-only. Added 50 A (15 sites; the rest 30 A), max 120 ft, pull-throughs, url/window/fcfs never/14-night max. Note corrected: all 45 sites have electric, not 38. Sewer left false (note-derived; the per-site pages leave Sewer Hookup blank). Season left absent: CPW's 'open year-round for camping' is park-wide and Iron Creek takes no winter bookings. Fees ($36 electric, June 2027) left as stored.
flags: Season: CPW says 'Crawford is open year-round for camping' and the cpwshop listing says 'Open year round', but Iron Creek sites 002/003 show not-available for every night from 2026-10-27 through 2027-05-03 while Clear Fork books all winter, so Iron Creek looks seasonal (Clear Fork is the winter campground). No page states Iron Creek's open/close dates, so neither season nor booking.season was written.

Split question: the evidence points to Iron Creek being a SEPARATE campground from Clear Fork (2297): its own entrance road off CO 92 at ~38.6723,-107.5981, ~0.8 km south of Clear Fork's; site centroids ~690 m apart (a little under the ~1 km guide). CPW names them as two campgrounds.
Pin 38.675,-107.5974 is ~270 m NNE of the site centroid (38.6736,-107.5999); within tolerance.
